name: price_tag
description: An offer: the old price is struck through, the new price slams down big in the brand's colour, and a round badge with the discount pops beside it. Only when the price - and the old price, if shown - was said in the video or written in the brief, word for word; never a price you worked out or guessed.

price.description: The price now, as said, e.g. '99 000 soʻm', '$49'.

old.description: Optional: the price before, as said; it is struck through.

badge.description: Optional: the discount as said, e.g. '-20%'.

label.description: Optional: a short line over it, e.g. 'Faqat bugun'. Written in capitals by the code.

beats.strike: The word the old price is struck through on.
beats.slam: The word the new price slams down on - the price itself.
